The corrected stable-signature closure reaches LocalEvidence.candidates -> CandidateSet, although docs/api-stability.md currently labels the historical candidate implementation experimental unless exposed. Parent and independent outside-package probes construct nonempty nominations with abstained=true through apply/copy/Mirror. Historical LocalEvidence.compute accepts the combination and retains CandidateProvenance.Unattested. This reproduces the construction and resulting record; it does not forge strict execution authority or establish occurrence in current study outputs.
Acceptance: decide whether abstained is caller-declared historical data or a checked relational invariant. Enforce the chosen invariant at all consuming boundaries or document the honest open payload contract, then settle its stable signature promotion before freeze. Preserve strict versus unattested provenance. Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/stability-audit-20261014/construction-probes/CandidateProbe.scala and CandidateProbe.log. FOLLOW-UP for the currently qualified study path; BLOCK for an unqualified stable-constructor claim.
set.title: Settle historical CandidateSet abstention semantics before stable API freeze
